kjv: all that make sluices [and] ponds for fish
mine: all who work for pay will be grieved
note: Hebrew 'ose-sekher 'agme-naphesh is "wage-earners, grieved of soul" ('agmei from 'agem "sad"); the KJV read sekher as "dam" and 'agam as "pond".
MT 'ir haheres "city of destruction"; some Hebrew manuscripts, the Dead Sea Isaiah scroll (1QIsa-a) and the Vulgate read hacheres "of the sun", i.e. Heliopolis (On), which I follow.
